notes.title: Double-Down, Localization, and More!
notes.content:
New Double-Down Mechanic!
Burn an additional card for a chance at earning MORE Utilities at the end of your turn. Only Utility cards payout on the second draw. Double-Down or Stand? Choose wisely...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/20a81299c16ea0e602587bc44f7f9fecd0781743.png

Hatchet Gets an Upgrade!
In addition to the Double Down mechanic, the Hatchet will now INCREASE the Double-Down payout (+2 Utilities per hatchet). The Hatchet will perform its normal "Cancel" effect if STAND is chosen instead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/f925ce0d843e19892d3f7e7e524015e2a69a3aee.png

Finally! an Exit button!
You can now exit back to the title screen by either clicking the button in the top-left, holding "Esc" (Keyboard), or "Start" (Controller)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/e4a862155a4511a22b27ac2bd346cce2682ac824.png

Small Suprise for SteamOS Users!
For users of SteamOS, the crowbar will take on a familiar appearance. *Steam version only.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/996939bc4c7034b4b74b90960c05698b8cc8f75d.png

Controller Support!
ARSONATE now natively supports controller input with glyphs which adapt to the current controller layout!
*Broken functionality for WebGL running on Linux. sry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/6ccc34a15d46819587ed3c30f46b0552dd949e98.png

ARSONATE is collaborating with IndieArk!
From the same publishers of Peglin, Backpack Hero, MISIDE, "Looking up I Only See a Ceiling", and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/89cf2fe1443b9cc8d7ae46a4da9a86604ecf5467.png

Localizations!
English, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Spanish (Argentina).
*Language is automatically determined on startup.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/e3eeb617531c2d7f09912b4b55fa4da4271a6203.png

Don't Forget Add Arsonate To Your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822980/_ARSONATE/

notes.title: About OTK Winter Game Expo, and multiplayer mode
notes.content:
The fire tower stands tall in the forest
Not a beacon for rangers, but a feast for the flames
Greetings,

The flames are burning brightly today — Arsonate is participating in the OTK Winter Game Expo. Hope this fire can warm you up during the chilly winter.
﻿
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/84ba543d0241949fc9ef51ee9d1b9dea3861d00a.jpg

As you may have noticed, the game has released a demo, which includes an unavailable ONLINE VS option.

It doesn’t seem like there’s any need to hide our ambition — the development of multiplayer mode is in progress, and a new host variant is planned to take part in the death game. 

[previewyoutube=ddpRiKce0oA;full][/previewyoutube]

[strike]We need more cremation objects.[/strike] (Pity.)
﻿
Prepare your fire mask and stay tuned for more info.

notes.title: Demo Update 9.06.2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872113/013d2275cb0d3a2fd727111577b39ac388a70ba8.png

-Added Audio settings menu.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE - Graveyard, Fair Mode Crowbar, Faster Sequences.
notes.content:
-Crowbars can no longer steal crowbars in "FAIR" mode.

-Graveyard is now visible.

-Graveyard is now explained in tutorial.

-Shortened various sequences.

-Now Possible to navigate using "A/D" or mouse wheel.

notes.title: Update: 03.16.2024
notes.content:
AI Fixes
Removed AI's "X-ray vision" when using Hatchet or Arson unless it's in "Handicap mode" (losing by more than 3 cards).
AI will always be delivered Arson when in Handicap mode.


Utility RNG Fixes
Utility RNG will default to Spyglass if it attempts to deliver a 3rd Hatchet. (Both players.)
Utility RNG will default to either Hatchet or Arson if it attempts to deliver a 3rd Spyglass. (Both players.)


New
Cool vignette appears when using the Spyglass.
